title: [main] It should not be possible to post invoices with a non-existing Posting Setup combination because it creates trouble with Adjust for Payment Discount.
summary: The system now validates that a General Posting Setup combination exists before posting journal invoices, preventing issues that arise later when processing payment discounts.
key_points: Gen. Jnl.-Check Line now checks that a General Posting Setup row exists for the business/product posting group pair
Combinations set up with a blank business posting group are still allowed; missing combinations are rejected
G/L journal invoices can no longer post with a product posting group that has no matching General Posting Setup
Prevents the failure that used to show up later when posting a payment discount
The check is added in W1 and several country layers, with tests in W1 and CZ
quote: Validate that the General Posting Setup row exists for the pair before posting.
